name: Read an unfamiliar technical instruction
short_description: Read an unfamiliar technical instruction once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can read an unfamiliar technical instruction in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Read an unfamiliar technical instruction means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Read an unfamiliar technical instruction in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Write a short instruction helps develop read an unfamiliar technical instruction but is not indispensable.
Repeat a spoken instruction accurately helps develop read an unfamiliar technical instruction but is not indispensable.
